title: Security grilles on buildings in occupancy groups B or M.
officialText:
Security grilles abutting sidewalks on buildings
in occupancy groups B or M shall comply with the retroactive requirements of item 4 of section 1008.1.4.5 of the New York
city building code. On and after July 1, 2026, such grilles when closed shall permit visibility from the sidewalk of at least
70 percent of the area covered by such grille.
